blockers.title: Governing requirement artifacts are unavailable
blockers.resolution: Obtain the three approved source revisions or controlled locators, record revision/size/SHA-256, and review derived mappings.

blockers.title: Two physical x86-64 A1 reference boards are not designated
blockers.resolution: Name and inventory two distinct physical boards, including firmware and devices, then retain acquisition/access records.

blockers.title: Ubuntu 24.04 reproducible baseline is absent
blockers.resolution: Build, digest, document, and reproduce an Ubuntu 24.04 baseline on the selected physical boards. Keep the observed 26.04 WSL guest as a separate evaluation path.

blockers.title: Disposable disk fixtures are unavailable
blockers.resolution: Provision separately identified disposable disks for both boards and record sanitization/reimage procedure.

blockers.title: Signing custody is a design only
blockers.resolution: Assign named custodians, create separated lab and production trust roots in approved protected storage, document rotation/revocation, and retain a signed verification exercise.

blockers.title: Model and runtime license candidates are not selected
blockers.resolution: Identify at least two 4-6B candidates, one mainstream comparison candidate, and their runtimes; record evaluation and redistribution decisions before acquiring assets.

blockers.title: G0 manual, security, and performance evidence is incomplete
blockers.resolution: Retain clean-checkout Ubuntu 24.04 and WSL workflow runs, secret/license/interface reviews, and labeled startup/request/memory/storage baselines without assigning a service class.

blockers.title: Large-model experiment capacity is unavailable
blocks: G1 real 400-405B placement/load result or measured hardware constraint
blockers.resolution: Secure suitable real hardware and legal assets, or record a measured blocking constraint on the specified experiment. The RTX 3050 laptop is not a substitute.
